title: Air Conditioning — Trim Air Valve — Installation of the Hardened Seat and Anti-Rotation Kit
abstract: Retrofit of the hardened trim air valve seat and its anti-rotation key on aircraft delivered before the production cut-in, restoring valve authority and ending the zone temperature drift reported on high-utilisation aircraft.

sections.planning_reason: Trim air valves that no longer hold their commanded position account for about one in nine of all cabin temperature write-ups on aircraft delivered before 2016. The cause is erosion of the soft valve seat by hot trim air, followed by rotation of the seat carrier in its housing, after which the zone drifts towards whatever the pack is delivering and the crew loses any useful control of cabin temperature. Operators are removing valves at roughly three times the published rate and the spares pool has not kept pace. Aircraft that are not modified will continue to generate cabin write-ups and unscheduled valve removals for the rest of their life.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin installs the hardened seat carrier and the machined anti-rotation key in the trim air valves of the forward and aft distribution runs, changes the inlet filter for a coarser element that does not blind when seat material sheds, and replaces the cover screws with the revised standard at a new torque figure. The valve bodies are retained. No ducting is cut, no bracket is moved and no wiring is disturbed.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Make sure that the air conditioning system is depressurised and that the packs are selected off. Get access through the ceiling panels in zones 254 and 291. Remove the ceiling closeout above the distribution run. Remove the valve at FIN 726HQ and the valve at FIN 980HQ following task AMM-Z-21-60-11-000-023-A. Put the valves on the bench and remove the covers. Remove the soft seat carrier and clean the housing. Machine the key slot with the supplied jig and install the hardened carrier ASH878362-87 with the key. Install the coarse filter KAD437362-51. Install the covers with the screws AES731670-69 and torque them in the sequence given on drawing D21601117401. Install the valves following task AMM-Z-21-60-11-400-023-A. Do the trim air system operational test and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to ZEPHYR-20, ZEPHYR-22 and ZEPHYR-24 aircraft that are not at the standard 2 trim air regulation configuration. Aircraft already at that standard carry the hardened seat as part of it and must not be modified again.
sections.material_note: Kit K2160-1206-01 contains two hardened seat carriers, two coarse filters, the cover screw set and the single-use key slot jig for one aircraft. The jig is returned to Aeralis after use. Removed seat carriers are scrap and are not returned.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled maintenance opportunity of four hours or more, or within 36 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
